company.name: Claim Health
company.shortDescription: Claim Health is a AI revenue platform that is fully automated through AI billing for healthcare industry.
company.description: Claim Health is a developer of an agentic AI platform for revenue cycle management in home health, hospice, and post-acute care organizations. The platform automates referral intake, eligibility verification, prior authorizations, billing operations, denial management, payment reconciliation, and revenue assurance workflows. Claim Health uses AI-powered automation and digital workers to reduce manual administrative tasks, identify revenue risks before claims are submitted, and improve visibility into financial performance.

productsAndServices.description: An AI-enabled platform for automating revenue operations across post-acute care, from referral intake and coverage checks through authorization, billing, payment reconciliation, and cash resolution.
